response.sql: WITH type_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM type_rates) SELECT tr.Name, tr.rate, tr.track_count, tr.rate - o.average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM type_rates AS tr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE tr.rate > o.average_rate

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is its total known bytes divided by the total milliseconds of those same tracks. Track count includes every track with a matching media type; undefined rates are excluded from the average.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type's rate is the average of its individual tracks' bytes-per-millisecond rates.
